symptom: ako/mxcli#1836 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1687): after moving entities and flows to another module, mx check (11.12.6) reported CE1613 'association Src.Order_Customer / entity Src.Customer no longer exists' at the moved entity's access rule; the rule kept Src.User and a moved nanoflow kept its Src grants while the microflow's were remapped. Enumeration/constant refs in expressions were already fixed (#1671, #1674).
cause: UpdateQualifiedNameInAllUnits matched whole strings, prefixes and RewriteExpressionReferences tokens, which deliberately skips path steps (an enumeration rename must not touch a same-named association); moveNanoflow had no remapDocumentAccessRoles call; nothing remapped entity access-rule roles.
file: mdl/types/expression_rename.go (RewritePathSteps), mdl/backend/modelsdk/infrastructure_write.go (path steps only when newName is an entity/association), mdl/executor/cmd_move.go (moveNanoflow remap, remapEntityAccessRoles)
insight: Whether a path step may be rewritten depends on the renamed element's KIND, which a name-based sweep cannot see — but after the move the element exists under its new name, so asking the domain models whether newName is an entity or association decides it without a new backend method.
